newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound averages 3.3922/3.3939 to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound averages 3.3922/3.3939 to dlr.

text.p: Private-sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3910 to 3.3930 bid and 3.3925 to 3.3970 offer in the interbank market on Monday.
A survey of five actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3922 pounds bid and 3.3939 offered. The averages compared to 3.3920 pounds bid and 3.3937 offered on Sunday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday (1000 GMT) as 3.393215 buy and 3.397830 sell.
